cycle.claim_boundary: The certificate applies only to exact fixed-leaf states in the preregistered strict inner graph/external-coordinate set on the sealed 17x17 model. It uses componentwise MPFR-85 round-to-nearest and the Q007y row-major h=2^-90 repair, then composes membership with Q007an. The coarse bound uses no center cancellation, spatial Fourier phase, or Q007z selected-wave result. It does not certify arbitrary Q007ag boundary states, arbitrary exact physical states, same-initial shadowing or trajectory error, performance, GPU or parallel reduction behavior, another grid or MPFR build, grid uniformity, a continuum limit, or D3Q27.
